payload.title: TenantContext seam through resolvers, jobs and rendering
payload.description:
What: one TenantContext (tenant id, plan state, host) is passed to every read, write, job and render. A fixed tenant for dedicated deployments. No global site state.
Acceptance:
Scenario: Two tenants in one process never mix
  Given tenants A and B built in the same run
  When both render
  Then each output contains only its own content and brand
